summary: Practise Article 6 transaction controls, registry reconciliation and buyer due diligence. Explore the course and assess its fit for your team.
lede: Article 6 carbon markets training helps project developers, climate officials and sustainability professionals manage traceable credit transactions. It covers Article 6.2 accounting and Article 6.4 processes, with practice mapping authorization and transfers, reconciling registry records, and reviewing buyer due diligence and claims. Participants also learn to assess community benefit commitments and flag safeguards risks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage carbon-credit transactions, project governance, community commitments or the review of carbon claims.
modules: Verra and Gold Standard Registry Controls
VCMI Claims and Buyer Due Diligence
prerequisites: Working familiarity with carbon projects, climate programmes or sustainability reporting is recommended. No programming is required. Comfort reviewing spreadsheets and project documentation will help you complete the transaction-record exercises.
